name: codex-traffic-light
description: Drive a USB-connected ESP32 traffic light from Codex lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex status on a USB traffic light.
interface.longDescription: Uses Codex lifecycle hooks to show working, waiting, complete, and ended states on an ESP32 traffic light over USB serial.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure or test my Codex traffic light.
